name: SuperGLUE
description: A harder successor to GLUE comprising 8 challenging English NLU tasks: BoolQ (yes/no QA), CB (three-way entailment), COPA (causal reasoning), MultiRC (multi-answer reading comprehension), ReCoRD (commonsense cloze QA), RTE (recognizing textual entailment), WiC (word sense disambiguation), and WSC (Winograd Schema Challenge). Designed to remain challenging after GLUE was quickly saturated.
evaluation_method: accuracy, F1 (task-specific); overall score is average of task scores
typical_sota_score: >90% (superhuman on aggregate; models like DeBERTa surpassed human baseline by 2021)
reputation: Successor to GLUE; widely cited in thousands of papers; used through 2021–2022 as the standard NLU benchmark before being superseded; hosted a public leaderboard at super.gluebenchmark.com
notes: Surpassed by DeBERTa by 2021; now largely obsolete for frontier evaluation. Some tasks (e.g., WSC, CB) are very small, making leaderboard scores unstable. No new tasks have been added since release. Top models in 2025 achieve superhuman aggregate scores. Introduced at NeurIPS 2019.
